messages:
Sam (CS): Hey team — Acme (Marco) hit a spike of 429s when their CI spins up ~150 workers during an init warmup. Seeing failures right at job start. Can we triage? :wave:
Priya (Eng): Ack. Marco, which SDK+version and can you paste any x-rate-limit headers and a snippet of how you call init?
Marco (Customer): We9re on js-sdk v2.1.0. Logs show:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 60
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 45
```
Happens within ~30s of starting CI.
Sam (CS): They spawn the 150 workers all at once in the warmup step.
Olivia (SRE): That looks like a preflight fanout on token/handshake budget plus conn churn.
Priya (Eng): Two immediate mitigations: 1) client-side stagger/jitter on sdk.init, 2) enable HTTP keepalive / connection reuse. Also reduce parallel init concurrency.
Marco (Customer): We do a naive parallel map: `workers.map(w => sdk.init({key: ENV.KEY}))` — all simultaneous.
Priya (Eng): Try this patch: add randomized delay and cap concurrency. Pseudocode:
```
await pMap(workers, async w => {
  await sleep(rand(100, 800))
  await sdk.init({key})
}, {concurrency: 6})
```
That should keep them under the token window (60/min bucket).
Sam (CS): Also set keepalive on Node: `agent: new https.Agent({keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 50})` to avoid repeated TLS handshakes.
Olivia (SRE): From infra we can grant a temporary onboarding rate bump to org-acme for their CI run and monitor, but recommend client pacing as the lasting fix.
onboard-bot: Ticket created CS-1029; requested temporary rate increase for org-acme.
Marco (Customer): Applied jitter+concurrency 6 and enabled keepalive. Re-ran CI — no 429s during warmup now. Thanks! :tada:
Priya (Eng): Great. We'll add a short cookbook note in onboarding docs: "Stagger SDK init and reuse connections for CI warmups."
Sam (CS): I9ll update Acme's account health notes and mark renewal risk mitigated. Also adding the resolved steps to their enablement checklist.
Olivia (SRE): I'll adjust monitoring alerts to a 1m window to reduce noise for rolling warmups. If they plan bigger scale tests we can coordinate a temporary Dedicated trial with Sales.
Marco (Customer): Confirmed stable. Appreciate the quick help.
Sam (CS): Closing loop — reach out if Acme needs quota for large scale load tests.
